_comment: Byte-exact boilerplate that indicates a package was copied rather than authored. A blocklist, not a similarity metric: open-ended similarity detection fires on legitimate sibling skills that share domain prose, so it gets deleted by the first person who runs it. These strings are inert in a genuinely authored skill.

stanzas.why: Part of an invented percentage breakdown (90/5/4/1) from a deprecated authoring guide. The numbers were never measured. Its presence means the section was pasted, not written.

stanzas.text: NEVER skip directly to writing inline code
stanzas.why: Same deprecated source. In several packages it sits trapped inside a code fence, which is the markdown artifact that proves it was copied verbatim.

stanzas.text: Do NOT constrain the agent to a specific PDF library
stanzas.why: Contradicts report delegation. Came from guidance that predates the report-generation skills.
